answer: Because the timing is entered against the voyage challenge, the walnut audit can replay the tide history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 196 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4105 identities would post 1555 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
